ledger.note: 1710: the pirate-born Ratsimilaho unites the Betsimisaraka clans. 'A zana-malata pirate named Ratsimilaho emerged to unite these clans under his rule in 1710.'
1712: Ratsimilaho captures Fenerive. 'He captured Fenerive in 1712'; he was then 'elected king of all the Betsimisaraka' (no year given). The page does not say from whom.

region.text: 'led an army of 25,000 soldiers from Antananarivo to successfully capture Toamasina'

ledger.note: 1817: Radama I takes Toamasina. 'The fractured Betsimisaraka kingdom was easily colonised in 1817 by Radama I'; he 'led an army of 25,000 soldiers from Antananarivo to successfully capture Toamasina'.
